question: Under the same Tail-V2 B12X/NVFP4 attention path and CUDA-graph state, what are full-CF32 KLD, five-cold-run determinism, and product prefill/decode speed for native P8 versus production EXL3?

quality_panel.metric: paired per-window KL(teacher || student), nats, causal rows, pinned FP64 CPU implementation
quality_panel.analysis_unit: window; repeat 1 only after determinism passes

common_runtime.tail_selector: tail-after-valid-history-v2, identical patched source SHA in both image receipts

p8.moe: native P8 mxf8f6f4 N64 fused scratch
p8.image: existing immutable Tail-V2 P8 capture image

exl3.image: TO BUILD: production EXL3 capture image plus identical Tail-V2 patch

storage.method: capture one window, validate and score, write and fsync score receipt, unlink only the authenticated raw, write retirement receipt, then request the next window
storage.retained: capture metadata, raw SHA-256, per-row score NPZ, window score receipt, runtime receipt, retirement receipt
storage.failed_or_partial_policy: stop and retain all failure/partial artifacts; never clean them automatically

determinism.pass: for every one of 64 arm-window cells, all five raw-logit SHA-256 values are identical
determinism.failure: preserve hashes and KLD but fail qualification; do not average repeats as n=160

speed.pass: P8 five-run median strictly exceeds EXL3 five-run median for both primary metrics
speed.failure: tie, regression, fewer than five valid runs, or any runtime-contract drift

blocking_prerequisites: build and receipt the EXL3 Tail-V2 image without GPU
verify identical patched KPool source SHA across P8 and EXL3 image receipts
generate and seal the resolved execution plan
production-service maintenance authority before later GPU execution
claim_boundary: This is the requested product comparison. The unavoidable P8 noEP/DCP1/E4M3 versus EXL3 EP4/DCP4/BF16 differences mean it is not a codec-only or matched-topology causal estimate.
